doc: Structure-tensor coherence: gaussian_filter(patch, 1.0) (default mode reflect, truncate 4.0; axis 0 then axis 1; the output keeps the input dtype), np.gradient (central differences inside, one-sided at the borders), products smoothed by gaussian_filter(sigma), coherence sqrt((jxx - jyy)^2 + 4 jxy^2) / (jxx + jyy) weighted by the trace. The two floors of the function: the per-pixel coherence is disc / max(trace, 1e-12) and the weighted mean is sum(coh * trace) / max(sum(trace), 1e-12). The patch is white noise scaled down to a tiny amplitude (values near 0, so the float64 chain keeps its full relative precision: no offset to absorb the digits). Scale 3e-6: per-pixel trace 3.6e-14..7.1e-14, total 1.32e-11: the pixel floor binds on every pixel and the total floor on none, so the result is exactly proportional to 1 / (pixel floor): a floor other than 1e-12 by 1 % moves it by 1 %. Float64 chain with no data-dependent branch: an independent float64 reimplementation (explicit reflect-padded kernel sums) agrees to 2.2e-16, a float64 one-ulp nudge of every texel moves the value by <= 4.4e-16; tolerance 1e-9.
